description: This file defines a command-line status command that shows the daemon state, including configuration, wake word status, and recent transcripts.

classes.name: StatusCommand
classes.description: A command structure conforming to ParsableCommand that implements the 'status' command to report daemon state, configuration, and recent transcripts.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously loads configuration, retrieves the latest transcripts, and prints the daemon status information.
